author: Donna Ridge Ingle
text: I used to be on the dexcom and my insurance also rejected it when the company I worked for changed plans.  Went on Medicare and they covered the Libre.  I recommend the 3+!  Reads straight to phone, no tapping the sensor with the phone unless you are starting a new one.  One piece design, no more snapping the sensor in after you put the holder on.  I love it!  Good luck!
